run.name: Pitney Bowes Inc
run.title: CP-OS host session (PBI)
run.summary: Pitney Bowes is a moderately leveraged, cash-generative credit with a secularly declining earnings base, adequate liquidity and no final maturity before March 2029, but distributions and a shrinking finance book weaken the debt-reduction story. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context; the EDGAR registrant name in that context is PITNEY BOWES INC /DE/.

revenue.basis: Total revenue, as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Debt principal 1,918.4 and cash 268.5 at 2026-09-30 (Q3 10-Q page:19, page:3) over LTM Adjusted EBITDA of 591.5: 572.9 plus nine months 2026 432.4 less nine months 2025 413.8 (Q3 release page:9). On the 2025 definition (removing the 23.1 add-back) the ratios are 3.38 and 2.90. Cash excludes short-term investments of 12.7. Not the covenant ratio.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. 591.5 over LTM cash interest 136.3: 142.1 plus nine months 2026 114.0 less nine months 2025 119.9 (Q3 10-Q page:26). On the 2025 definition the cover is 4.17. Cash interest timing is uneven across quarters because coupons are semi-annual, so only LTM and annual figures are shown.

cash.basis: Cash. Remaining borrowing capacity as printed (Q3 10-Q page:20); nothing drawn. Cash includes 64 held at foreign subsidiaries (Q3 10-Q page:34); short-term investments of 12.7 are excluded. The credit-agreement definition of liquidity is not supplied.

cashflow.basis: Net cash from operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Covenant headroom, legal capacity to distribute or add debt, and ownership cannot be tested because the credit agreement, indentures and proxy statement are not supplied.

CP-1 main limitation: Adjusted EBITDA is calculated for FY2025 and LTM, adds back terminated-plan pension expense in 2026 only, and covenant headroom cannot be calculated without the credit agreement.
